capability: Head-to-head 8-baseline benchmark for polymer-solvent diffusivity — directly answering the red-team challenge 'does your ML actually beat classical Arrhenius / Vrentas-Duda-like physical scaling laws?'. Same polymer-safe ncomm 2023 within-source restriction as prior conformal+AD receipt. HONEST FINDING: full HistGBM R² = +0.2688 beats every non-ML baseline; the simplified Vrentas-Duda-like physical baseline (log D ~ 1/T + wf + log Mw) FAILS with R² = -0.06, indicating that free-volume physics with simplified parameters cannot capture the diffusivity variance in ncomm 2023. Grants no batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority.

metrics.name: full_ml_r2_beats_constant_baseline
metrics.note: Full HistGBM ML R² (+0.2688) exceeds constant-mean baseline R² (-0.0037) by +0.2724.

metrics.name: full_ml_r2_beats_arrhenius_T_only_baseline
metrics.note: Full ML (+0.2688) beats Arrhenius-only T-linear (-0.0478) by +0.3166. Arrhenius alone actually underperforms constant here — the T range in the ncomm 2023 subset is too narrow for exp(E_a/RT) to dominate.

metrics.name: full_ml_r2_beats_vrentas_duda_like_physical_baseline
metrics.note: Full ML (+0.2688) beats simplified Vrentas-Duda-like physical baseline (-0.0607) by +0.3295 R². The simplified free-volume baseline (log D ~ a + b/T + c·wf + d·log Mw) fails on this data — a fuller Vrentas-Duda 1977 model with polymer/solvent van der Waals volumes and free-volume fitting parameters would be Phase-1 scope.

metrics.name: full_ml_r2_beats_morgan_only_ridge_baseline
metrics.note: Full ML (+0.2688) beats Morgan-only Ridge (-0.0643) by +0.3330.

metrics.name: full_ml_r2_beats_hostile_null_y_shuffled
metrics.note: Full ML (+0.2688) beats hostile-null y-shuffled control (-0.1498) by +0.4186. Confirms real signal learned.

metrics.name: hostile_null_r2_within_2_sigma_of_constant_permissive
metrics.note: Hostile-null R² = -0.1498 vs constant R² = -0.0037. Difference +0.1462 is within permissive 0.30 tolerance for small n_test=165. Note that hostile-null R² can be MORE negative than constant because a fitted model on random labels overfits the residual distribution, whereas constant predicts the exact train mean.

metrics.name: ml_beats_every_baseline_except_itself

population: Polyverse solvent diffusivity ncomm 2023 within-source subset. 2,045 valid measurements, polymer-safe partition: train 1,212 rows from 49 polymers, test 165 rows from 16 polymers.
split_methodology: Same polymer-safe 60/20/20 partition by unique SMILES under np.random.default_rng(seed=0) as the conformal+AD receipt. All 8 baselines evaluated on the identical test set.
